rationale: Transurban Chesapeake and Chesapeake toll road network are duplicate records for the same Transurban Chesapeake LLC manager-level concession platform. Direct Transurban, AustralianSuper and CPP Investments evidence establishes a current cap table of Transurban 50%, AustralianSuper 25%, CPP Investments 15% and UniSuper 10%. This proposal preserves the existing AustralianSuper and CPP ownership-period identities, moves the AustralianSuper period onto the canonical company through the reviewed production merge, corrects both disclosed stakes, replaces the unsupported 2020 founding year and geographic headquarters with unavailable values, and records Northern Virginia as the operating footprint in the description. The 495, 95 and 395 Express Lanes, FredEx and 495 NEXT remain components rather than separate PortCos. No platform sale, secondary transfer or signed pending exit was found through August 18, 2026.

beforeImage.name: Transurban Chesapeake
beforeImage.description: Transurban Chesapeake owns the 495, 95, and 395 Express Lanes system serving the greater Washington, D.C. region. Its customers are passenger and commercial motorists that pay variable tolls for managed-lane access and travel-time reliability. The platform is asset-heavy and concession-based because value depends on long-dated toll-road rights, lane assets, traffic demand, and ongoing operations. CPP Investments disclosed in 2020 that it acquired a 15% interest, and subsequent Transurban investor materials show a current ownership split of 50% Transurban, 25% AustralianSuper, 15% CPP Investments, and 10% UniSuper. The asset base remains a core managed-lanes platform in Virginia, Maryland, and the District of Columbia.

afterImage.name: Transurban Chesapeake
afterImage.description: Transurban Chesapeake LLC is the concession platform that owns the entities operating the 495, 95 and 395 Express Lanes in Northern Virginia, including the Fredericksburg Extension and 495 NEXT. It develops, finances, operates and maintains dynamically priced express lanes serving motorists, high-occupancy vehicles, buses and permitted commercial traffic in partnership with VDOT. At June 30, 2026, Transurban reported 50% ownership, AustralianSuper 25%, CPP Investments 15% and UniSuper 10%; only AustralianSuper and CPP Investments are tracked infrastructure-manager owners here. The 495 concession covered 26.5 kilometres and the 95/395/FredEx concession 79 kilometres, each running through December 2087. No platform sale, secondary transfer or signed pending exit was identified through August 18, 2026. Chesapeake Partnership and Chesapeake toll road network are aliases for the same manager-level platform; individual roads and extensions are components, not separate PortCos.

milestones.event: The 395 Express Lanes opened to traffic as part of the Chesapeake managed-lanes platform.
Transurban established the Chesapeake partnership structure around its 495, 95 and 395 Express Lanes assets in connection with the announced 50% institutional partner sale.
CPP Investments announced a 15% Chesapeake interest on December 16 and AustralianSuper announced a 25% interest on December 17; UniSuper agreed to acquire 10% and Transurban would retain 50%.
Transurban completed the sale of a 50% interest in Transurban Chesapeake to AustralianSuper, CPP Investments and UniSuper on March 31, 2021; reporting became effective April 1.
VDOT and Transurban opened the 10-mile 95 Express Lanes Fredericksburg Extension to mainline traffic.
